units: <cite ref="Shabbat 16b:8">Sabb. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעת ק׳ עבים</he> when the clouds were gathering, opp. <cite ref="Q00609"><he>פיזור</he></cite>.

Ib. XV, 1 כשם שהוא חייב על קִישּׁוּרָן וכ׳ as well as he is guilty (of violating the Sabbath laws), when he ties them (the knots) &c., opp. התיר. Y. ib. IV, 7ᵃ top; a. e.—Pl. קִישּׁוּרִים, קִשּׁ׳ (b. h. קִשֻּׁרִים) beads, decorations.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 32:2">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXII</cite>, end <he>ככלה בקִשּׁוּרֶיהָ</he> like a bride in her attire; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 114:4">Yalk. Gen. 114</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:9">ib. VI, 9</cite>), <he>קִשּׁוּרֵי פואה</he> (Ms. M. <he>קישור פיאה</he>), v. <cite ref="Q00151"><he>פּוּאָה</he></cite>; Y. ib. VI, 8ᶜ <he>בקושרי פיאה</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.
